goal: Fix a broken environment variable in the depends build system so cmake-based packages find dependencies built by depends instead of system libraries.
Prevents a compile error when building native_libmultiprocess with a conflicting system-installed CapnProto.
reviewability: Stale, author has not responded since April 2026 despite unresolved design discussion and a status check in August.
agreement: Disputed: hebasto and purpleKarrot question whether preserving an external CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH value undermines the depends system's isolation goal, and purpleKarrot proposes a simpler variant of the fix (purpleKarrot, hebasto).
Author defended the current approach with a rationale but conversation stalled without resolution (ryanofsky).

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it fixes a real compile-time failure ("Version mismatch between generated code and library headers") in the native_libmultiprocess depends package, but only triggers when a conflicting system CMake package (e.g. via nix) shadows the depends-built one.
Narrow trigger conditions limit how many contributors feel this; it does not affect the mainline build for most developers.

result.summary: This one-line change to depends/funcs.mk replaces a non-functional CMAKE_MODULE_PATH environment assignment with CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH, which is the variable cmake actually reads from the environment and the one relevant for config-mode find_package() calls used by modern packages like CapnProto. The change prepends the depends prefix onto any existing CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH value, mirroring how PATH is already handled elsewhere in the file.
result.problem: Building cmake-based depends packages (notably native_libmultiprocess) could pick up a system-installed CapnProto instead of the depends-built one, producing a hard compile error ("Version mismatch between generated code and library headers"). This affects contributors building with the MULTIPROCESS depends option in environments (e.g. Nix shells) where a conflicting system package is present.

open_concerns: hebasto: preserving an externally-set CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH value seems to undermine the depends system's isolation goal; suggested setting CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH explicitly per-package (as qt.mk does) instead.

purpleKarrot: proposes a simpler variant that does not preserve the prior CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH value, leaving the question of preserving external env vars for separate discussion; also notes CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX as an environment variable requires CMake 3.29, above the project's 3.22 minimum, relevant to an alternative fix discussed.
sedited (2026-08-10) asked for a status update; no reply.
resolved_concerns: hebasto's suggestion to rely on CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX was addressed by ryanofsky explaining why it does not control dependency search, without further pushback from hebasto on that specific point.

agreement.summary: Disputed: hebasto and purpleKarrot question the approach of preserving external CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH; author defended it but discussion stalled with no resolution.
agreement.reason: Two reviewers (hebasto, purpleKarrot) raised a substantive design concern about whether the fix should preserve or override any externally set CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH, proposing a simpler alternative; the author gave a rationale for the current approach but neither side reached agreement, and the author has not replied since.

purpleKarrot: proposes dropping the preserved prior value as "the proper fix"

enables: Correct native_libmultiprocess builds under the depends system, relevant to the multiprocess/IPC project

categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Directly modifies depends/funcs.mk, the shared depends build logic, and is labeled Build system.
categories.rationale: Fixes a genuine compile-time failure in the depends build of native_libmultiprocess caused by a non-functional CMAKE_MODULE_PATH assignment, per the description: cmake never read CMAKE_MODULE_PATH from the environment and CapnProto uses config-mode discovery which needs CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH. The bug is real but narrowly triggered (only when a conflicting system package shadows the depends-built one, as with a Nix shell), limiting its reach across the build category.

uncertainties: Whether the disputed design question (preserving external CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH vs not) is severe enough to be a blocking objection or just a nonblocking style/architecture preference.
No linked issue confirms how many contributors actually hit this failure outside the author's own Nix environment.
result.card: This PR fixes a one-line bug in depends/funcs.mk, replacing a non-functional CMAKE_MODULE_PATH environment assignment with the correct CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH, which cmake's config-mode find_package (used by CapnProto and other modern cmake packages) actually reads. It fixes a real compile error in native_libmultiprocess ("Version mismatch between generated code and library headers") that occurs when a conflicting system-installed dependency (e.g. via Nix) shadows the depends-built one. Reviewers hebasto and purpleKarrot raised a substantive but unresolved design concern about whether the fix should preserve externally set CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH values, proposing a simpler alternative; the author defended the current approach but has been silent since 2026-04-15, and a later status-check comment went unanswered. The fix is narrow in scope, mattering mainly to contributors building the MULTIPROCESS depends option in environments with conflicting system packages.
